observations.quote: It’s not helping, and I don’t think it’s getting away from the print. I’m clearing plate now.
observations.assessment: User reports no benefit and perceives insufficient nozzle clearance. Actual physical contact and stop layer are not established.

evidence_scope: User reports no stringing benefit and insufficient apparent clearance during the trial. No finished-part acceptance, measured contact, socket-fit, pressure, retention or lifetime result.

post_stop_telemetry.scope: Idle cancelled-job state; reset layer counters do not identify the printed stop layer.
